verdict.rationale: Codex CLI is officially documented as OpenAI's local coding agent (codex-gh-1), with sign-in via ChatGPT plans or API key (codex-gh-3, codex-gh-4), and is referenced as a core workflow interface alongside the web app (codex-docs-7). Community discussion also treats Codex CLI as a real, actively used tool, confirming it functions in practice despite performance complaints unrelated to its existence as a CLI.
